title: One week at Techline
headline: One week at *Techline*
sub: Orders, riders, stock, money and deals, all run alongside his chats.

reel.caption: Ikenna signs up and sets up Techline in minutes.

narration.en: Ikenna signs up and sets up his business in minutes.
narration.pcm: Ikenna sign up and set up im business for few minutes.

reel.caption: One phone, nine sizes and colours, each counted.

narration.en: One phone in every storage and colour, each with its own count.
narration.pcm: One phone for every storage and colour, each get im own count.

reel.caption: A WhatsApp order becomes an order card.

narration.en: When a customer orders on WhatsApp, Taskiem reads it into an order card.
narration.pcm: When customer order for WhatsApp, Taskiem go read am into order card.

reel.caption: Money arrives and finds its invoice.

narration.en: When the money arrives, he matches it to the invoice.
narration.pcm: When money enter, he go match am to the invoice.

reel.caption: A rider takes it, and he follows it.

narration.en: A rider takes the order, and Ikenna follows it to the door.
narration.pcm: Rider go carry the order, and Ikenna go follow am reach door.

reel.caption: Maryam hands the shift over, cash counted.

narration.en: Maryam hands the shift over, and the cash is counted.
narration.pcm: Maryam go hand the shift over, and dem go count the cash.

reel.caption: Phones running low? Reorder in a few taps.

narration.en: When the Nova X5 runs low, he reorders from Gwarzo in a few taps.
narration.pcm: When Nova X5 dey finish, he go reorder from Gwarzo with few taps.

reel.caption: A deal, within the limits he sets.

narration.en: Kehinde haggles. Maryam deals within his limits, and he approves the rest.
narration.pcm: Kehinde dey haggle. Maryam go deal inside im limits, and he go approve the rest.

narration.en: Every morning, his numbers are waiting in one card.
narration.pcm: Every morning, im numbers dey wait for one card.

reel.caption: Nothing goes out without his OK.

narration.en: And nothing goes out without his OK.
narration.pcm: And nothing go out without im OK.

bridge.en: It starts with opening the shop.
bridge.pcm: Everything start with how he go open the shop.

flow.action: Serves three customers at once across the glass counter while two phones ring; he answers one with a grin and waves the next customer forward
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter
flow.camera: slow push-in, medium shot, warm light

flow.action: Wipes down the glass counter at the end of the week, checks his phone, smiles with quiet pride and pulls the shutter halfway down
